understanding: Coordinate normal_traffic with wishbone payload plus uart TX RX plus modem toggles under IER-gated interrupt observe, and loopback_traffic by programming MCR Loopback 1 for internal TX-shift to RX-shift with documented modem remapping, reusing t_wb_init_cfg divisor line FIFO IER base with DLAB 0.
preconditions: WAIT for clock running at fixed period per test and reset released
REQUIRE t_wb_init_cfg_init_seq DONE with LCR DLAB 0 so normal registers accessible and wishbone bus idle-owned for handoff
REQUIRE symbolic bring-up divisor plus line-format plus FIFO trigger plus IER enables programmed; IER enables use symbolic SYM_IER with documented bits 3-0 polarity
REQUIRE MCR Loopback starting at normal 0; use symbolic SYM_PAYLOAD and SYM_MODEM_LEVELS without inventing bus values
stimulus_steps: STAGE normal_directed: SPAWN virtual normal_traffic_sequence that spawns only; wishbone_slave_interface spawns wishbone payload moves owning wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_sel_i, uart_serial_data spawns RX drives owning srx_pad_i and observes stx_pad_o, modem_control_if spawns handshake toggles owning cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i and observes rts_pad_o dtr_pad_o, interrupt_output observes int_o

FOR each SYM_BURST with SYM_LEN: wishbone_slave_interface WRITE symbolic THR payload bytes; uart_serial_data DRIVE symbolic srx_pad_i frames with SYM_LINE matching LCR; modem_control_if DRIVE symbolic handshake levels; WAIT for wb_ack_o then wishbone_slave_interface READ symbolic RBR; observe stx_pad_o and int_o

STAGE loopback_directed: wishbone_slave_interface WRITE MCR Loopback 1 using symbolic MCR address; WAIT for idle; FOR each SYM_LOOP_BYTES: wishbone_slave_interface WRITE symbolic THR payload; WAIT for internal TX-to-RX transfer; wishbone_slave_interface READ symbolic RBR; modem_control_if OBSERVE remapped levels; interrupt_output OBSERVE int_o

STAGE random: FOR seed-controlled iterations: wishbone_slave_interface RANDOMIZE payload bytes with corner bias all-zeros all-ones within documented IER and MCR legal values 0 1; uart_serial_data RANDOMIZE gaps and TX versus RX interleave; modem_control_if RANDOMIZE handshake timing; IF Loopback equals 1 THEN constrain to internal transfer ELSE drive external serial
check_steps: COMPARE loopback TX queue versus RX queue in order filtered by origin and address excluding configuration writes; PASS when order preserved without loss duplication or misorder
COMPARE stx_pad_o equals 1 WHILE MCR Loopback equals 1
COMPARE IER readback versus programmed enables for bits 3-0 with reserved 7-4 as 0
coverage_steps: SAMPLE modem routing normal versus loopback via modem_control_if monitor tap on RTS_PAD_O DTR_PAD_O CTS_PAD_I DSR_PAD_I RI_PAD_I DCD_PAD_I plus MCR Loopback value
SAMPLE interrupt enables via wishbone_slave_interface monitor tap on IER bits 3-0 values
SAMPLE payload bytes with corner bias all-zeros all-ones via wishbone_slave_interface monitor tap and uart_serial_data monitor tap on TX versus RX
completion: Done when directed normal burst plus directed loopback burst plus bounded random bursts all ACKed with queues COMPAREd and coverage SAMPLEd
Bound by TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES operational limit; timeout is testbench limit not DUT timing
Cleanup: program MCR Loopback to 0 for normal, leave LCR DLAB 0 with wishbone bus idle-owned for handoff

facts.statement: IER bit 0 enables Received Data available interrupt with 0 disabled and 1 enabled.
facts.quote:
0 RW Received Data available interrupt
 ‘0’ – disabled
 ‘1’ – enabled

facts.statement: IER bit 1 enables Transmitter Holding Register empty interrupt with 0 disabled and 1 enabled.
facts.quote:
1 RW Transmitter Holding Register empty interrupt
 ‘0’ – disabled
 ‘1’ – enabled

facts.statement: IER bit 2 enables Receiver Line Status interrupt with 0 disabled and 1 enabled.
facts.quote:
2 RW Receiver Line Status Interrupt
 ‘0’ – disabled
 ‘1’ – enabled

facts.statement: IER bit 3 enables Modem Status interrupt with 0 disabled and 1 enabled.
facts.quote:
3 RW Modem Status Interrupt
 ‘0’ – disabled
 ‘1’ – enabled

facts.statement: MCR bit 4 selects normal versus loopback with STX_PAD_O set to 1 and transmitter shift internally connected to receiver shift in loopback.
facts.quote:
4 W Loopback mode
 ‘0’ – normal operation
 ‘1’ – loopback mode. When in loopback mode, the Serial
Output Signal (STX_PAD_O) is set to logic ‘1’. The signal of the
transmitter shift register is internally connected to the input of the
receiver shift register.

facts.statement: In loopback DTR connects to DSR and RTS to CTS and Out1 to RI and Out2 to DCD.
facts.quote:
The following connections are made:
DTR Î  DSR
RTS Î CTS
Out1 Î RI
Out2 Î DCD

facts.statement: MCR bits 0 and 1 control DTR and RTS levels with inverted polarity.
facts.quote:
0 W Data Terminal Ready (DTR) signal control
 ‘0’ – DTR is ‘1’
 ‘1’ – DTR is ‘0’
1 W Request To Send (RTS) signal control
 ‘0’ – RTS is ‘1’
 ‘1’ – RTS is ‘0’

facts.statement: LCR bit 7 selects divisor latches when 1 and normal registers when 0.
facts.quote:
7 RW Divisor Latch Access bit.
 ‘1’ – The divisor latches can be accessed
 ‘0’ – The normal registers are accessed
